statement: HHD encodes gyro X/Y/Z as signed 16-bit fields in the DualSense enhanced input report, with acceleration as adjacent signed fields and an IMU timestamp as a 32-bit little-endian counter derived from incoming nanoseconds divided by 333. It chooses USB or Bluetooth report framing and offsets, and can synchronize emitted reports to incoming gyro/accel/IMU timestamp events for Steam gyro-to-mouse behavior. A roughly two-second absent-IMU fallback permits synthetic monotonic report timestamps; Bluetooth input reports receive CRC32.

applicability.revision: HHD adbd50ff and SDL 3.4.18 compatibility source, no independent DualSense hardware comparison
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. HHD const.py 16, 25-30, 69-147 and __init__.py 363-395, 436-442, 516-548. HHD's Steam rationale is source commentary, not a proven Steam internal requirement.
